object_description: compact two-storey volume organized around an inner courtyard
design_condition: The building is precisely integrated into the site along the existing alignment, shaping a generous street space while its courtyard, tree-lined garden, and roof sports area provide varied open spaces around and above the compact volume.

positive.statement: The urban positioning precisely integrates the compact structure into the site and establishes a clear presence along the avenue.

position.rationale: Outer footprint visibly aligns along the avenue-facing south edge.

positive.statement: The project creates a diverse spectrum of spatially, atmospherically, and functionally convincing open spaces.

position.rationale: Courtyard and perimeter open zones are visible around the compact volume.

positive.statement: The separation of functions is implemented consistently and naturally, with a good flow of patients and carefully chosen room proportions.

position.rationale: Interior organization is approximated within the visible building envelope.

positive.statement: The circulation around the courtyard provides very good orientation and varied meeting zones, while the spiral staircase creates a generous logical connection across all floors.

position.rationale: Central courtyard is clear; the connecting stair is inferred within it.

positive.statement: The clear structures and courtyard allow orientation through visual connections and optimal networking between user groups.

position.rationale: Courtyard-centered organization provides the strongest visible shared orientation anchor.

positive.statement: The clear routing naturally provides access to the various functions.

position.rationale: Routes are approximated through the courtyard-centered footprint.

positive.statement: Delivery and internal operations are well organized, offices are well lit, and open-plan offices can easily be converted into group offices.

position.rationale: Operational and office functions are approximated in the east upper building zone.

positive.statement: The sports hall and adjoining rooms are well connected and sensibly organized.

position.rationale: Lower-level peripheral volume is used as the likely sports-related zone.

positive.statement: The proposal meets the various requirements and is convincing in its architectural, functional, economic, urban-design, structural, and operational approach.

position.rationale: The judgment addresses the project comprehensively across architectural and operational criteria.

negative.statement: The sports hall cannot be rented separately from the lecture hall and gymnastics room, so accessibility must be improved.

position.target: sports hall, lecture hall, and gymnastics room access
position.rationale: Lower-level west-side program zone approximates the linked hall access issue.

negative.statement: The use of the roof as a sports break area should be reconsidered and coordinated with target-group requirements.

position.rationale: Distinct U-shaped attic and roof zone are visible at the upper building level.

negative.statement: The lowered lecture hall prevents barrier-free access for lecturers.

position.rationale: Sunken lower-level volume is approximated along the west side.

negative.statement: The entrance is not easily recognizable from the avenue.

position.rationale: The avenue-facing south edge is visible, but no entrance feature is distinguishable.

negative.statement: The cafeteria has no connection to the western courtyard garden.

position.rationale: Western courtyard-side lower zone approximates the stated cafeteria relationship.

negative.statement: The homogeneous façade does not reveal the different uses from outside.

position.rationale: Elevation views visibly show a largely uniform facade treatment.

negative.statement: The incidence of light in the sports hall must be checked to prevent possible grazing light.

position.rationale: Southwest lower facade approximates the sports hall daylight condition.

negative.statement: Summer heat insulation has not been sufficiently explained.

position.rationale: The comment concerns environmental performance without a useful geometric marker.

negative.statement: It remains unclear whether the openable windows can function with the mechanical ventilation system.

position.rationale: A south facade window band provides the nearest visible envelope anchor.

negative.statement: The load-bearing construction is only partially legible, limiting cost calculation.

position.rationale: Structural legibility is assessed against the overall sampled volume.

negative.statement: The courtyard, extensive glazing, U-shaped attic, and roofs imply high façade-envelope and roof costs.

position.rationale: Top and elevation views visibly support the courtyard, glazing, attic, and roof cost concerns.
